detail.longDescription:
📦 Looking for an all-in-one app that handles every file format?
PDF Reader brings together a powerful reader, professional editor, and intelligent scanner into one seamless mobile office. Whether you're at home, in the office, or on the go, managing documents has never been this effortless.

💡 Why Choose PDF Reader?
- Multi-Format Viewer: No more app switching. Open and read PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and EPUB files with an all-in-one document reader.
- Smooth Annotation: Highlight key text, add underlines, or add comments. Use the signature tool to sign contracts in seconds.
- Smart Scanning: Turn your camera into a high-definition scanner. Capture receipts, ID cards, or notes and save them as crystal-clear PDFs.
- AI-Powered Insights: Don't have time to read? Let our built-in AI summarize documents for you by extracting key points and action items instantly.

🛠️ Powerful Document Toolkit
- PDF to Image: Convert specific pages into high-resolution JPGs for easy sharing.
- Image Extraction: Pull embedded images out of any document with one tap.
- File Optimization: Merge multiple files, split documents, or use our compression tool to save storage space.
- Security First: Protect sensitive information with encryption and password tools.

📁 Efficient File Management
- Keep your workspace tidy with custom folders, smart search, and easy sorting.
- All files are stored locally and neatly organized, ensuring quick access whenever you need them.

🚀 Optimized for Performance
Built for speed and reliability. Open large files without lag, enjoy smooth scrolling, and switch between tools with a clean, intuitive interface designed for both phones and tablets.
Perfect for Students, Professionals, and Everyone in between.
Download PDF Reader now and experience the smarter way to manage your digital world!

📃 Supported File Formats
We support a wide range of practical formats to meet all your professional and daily needs:
- Documents: PDF, DOCX, DOCM, DOC, DOT, DOTX, DOTM, RTF, TXT
- Spreadsheets: XLSX, XLS, XLSM, CSV
- Presentations: PPTX, PPT, PPS, POT, PPTM, POTX
- eBooks & Notes: EPUB, MOBI, FB2, MD (Markdown)
- And more!
